summary: The four-line registry addition matches the existing hyphenated SVG filenames and preserves toolbar behavior. No actionable source-level UX finding was identified. This is not a build, test, native UI, or CI success claim.

source_checks.evidence: The exact base-to-reviewed-commit diff changes only crates/icons/src/icons.rs, adding AndroidStudioAdd and AndroidStudioClose with their two explicit Strum serialize attributes. No existing variant, path function, or test is changed.

source_checks.check: Registry naming and asset path consistency
source_checks.evidence: crates/icons/src/icons.rs:32-35 explicitly sets android-studio-add and android-studio-close rather than deriving snake_case names. IconName::path at lines 320-324 uses IntoStaticStr to produce icons/{file_stem}.svg, matching assets/icons/android-studio-add.svg and assets/icons/android-studio-close.svg. EnumString consumes the same Strum names. Existing names retain their mappings.

The committed crates/android_ui/src/tabbed_toolbar.rs is identical to the base. The production close button still uses Icon::from_path("icons/android-studio-close.svg") at lines 456-458. Existing add-action test consumers retain Icon::from_path("icons/android-studio-add.svg"). There are no new consumers of AndroidStudioAdd or AndroidStudioClose. Selection, close, add callbacks, geometry, scrolling, hover, focus styling, tooltips, and accessibility labels are untouched. Icon::from_path treats icons/ paths as embedded SVGs independently of the registry.

The unchanged toolbar Tab handler at lines 268-285 still traverses only when control, alt, platform, and function modifiers are absent; Shift chooses reverse traversal. Explicit tab stops, Space activation, event propagation, close/action focus handling, and existing keyboard tests are unchanged. The registry additions contain no event or shortcut code.

The attributes govern Strum's string parsing and static string conversion. Serde derives and existing Serde names are untouched; the two new variants receive the enum's existing default Serde convention, and the change introduces no Serde consumer. EnumIter now includes the two variants; the observed UI consumer is the all-icons example gallery in crates/ui/src/components/icon.rs:329-352, so it gains those two entries without changing toolbar behavior.

git diff --exit-code between the base and reviewed commit is empty for both SVG assets, assets/android-studio-attribution.md, and crates/android_ui/src/tabbed_toolbar.rs. The SVGs retain the 16-by-16 geometry and their embedded AOSP Apache 2.0 copyright/license notices.

The unchanged test_all_icons_exist at crates/icons/src/icons.rs:335 verifies a file exists for every enumerated icon path. The unchanged test_no_dangling_icons at line 348 parses every SVG stem into IconName; the added explicit names address the reported VariantNotFound cause without exemptions. The unchanged toolbar tests cover callbacks, geometry, overflow/resizing, Tab/Shift-Tab, modified Tab, and close/action focus. .github/workflows/fork_ci.yml and script/ci-test-selection are unchanged: the planner selects changed Rust packages and conservative reverse dependents while nextest retains --workspace compilation. The icons tests remain within selected-package coverage.

validation_limitations.build: NOT RUN: the lead agent owns all runtime validation; this reviewer did not invoke Cargo or modify build/cache state.
validation_limitations.tests: NOT RUN: test bodies and CI selection were inspected only. No test execution or CI result was independently verified.
validation_limitations.native_ui: NOT RUN: the app was not launched, and no native surface capture or full-app screenshot was taken. Actual icon rendering, theme/scale appearance, keyboard interaction, and runtime behavior are unverified by this review.
validation_limitations.completion_requirement: AGENTS.md and .rules require a full app build and affected-flow exercise before implementation completion. This source-only pass does not satisfy that requirement; the lead agent retains it.
validation_limitations.source_access: Some tracked toolbar/UI/attribution files were absent from the current working tree. They were inspected with git show or git grep at the exact reviewed commit. No checkout changes were made.
